[LEARN:anac] sas.anac.gov.br (airfares) blocks bursts scripted requests HTML “Requisição Bloqueada” page served HTTP 200 → status codes alone don’t prove success; check content type / first bytes, keep max_active low. title: flightsbr (development version)
text: Breaking changes: read_airfares() now returns column names every period, using names ANAC’s current files: nr_ano_referencia, nr_mes_referencia, sg_empresa_icao, sg_icao_origem, sg_icao_destino, nr_tarifa, nr_assentos, international flights also sg_icao_retorno, cd_classe_ida cd_classe_volta. Older names ano, tarifa valor_tarifa longer returned, still accepted select. Identifier columns longer converted numbers, keep leading zeros: nr_voo nr_chave (read_flights()), nr_voo_numero (read_airport_movements()), nr_serie nr_cert_matricula (read_aircraft()). generally, column named like number (nr_*, qt_*, …) converted numeric values numbers. Otherwise stays character, message values problem (e.g. nr_preco_venda recent RAB files). type column can therefore differ requests different months. read_aircraft(): registration mark column always called marcas (marca files 2026), empty cells text "null" returned NA. Bug fixes: Fixed read_airport_movements() returning NA every airport, airline aircraft code: codes nr_* columns converted numbers. Fixed read_aircraft() returning NA many serial numbers almost sale prices, use Brazilian number formatting ("1.500.000,00"). Fixed failed downloads cached: ANAC answers missing files blocked requests HTML page, saved later read data cache = TRUE. Files now downloaded temporary file kept download succeeded web page. Downloads retried run four time. Fixed read_airfares() splitting fares columns separate, half-empty columns requested months use different ANAC headers. Files unknown header now fail error. Fixed read_airfares() failing months ANAC re-uploaded another name (e.g. May 2026, 202605 (1).csv). Download links now come ANAC’s listing. Fixed read_aircraft(), read_airport_movements() read_airfares() year (date = yyyy) failing whenever month year available ANAC. now read available months list missing ones message. Fixed read_airports() returning NA coordinates 29% private airports (seconds written decimal comma), altitude 0 airports whose altitude missing (",0"). latgeopoint longeopoint now numeric. Fixed JSON owner operator columns recent RAB files (proprietarios, operadores) valid JSON. read_aircraft() warns requested months use different RAB layouts. Fixed page without flight file table cached bogus listing, broke read_flights() rest session. latest_flights_date() returns NULL instead -Inf ANAC can’t reached. read_airfares() rejects domestic = NA vectors length > 1. Large text files extracted flight zip files deleted read. Functions longer change number threads used data.table. Fixed read_flights() failing download data. ANAC’s website now lists flight files relative links lead HTML page instead zip file. package now builds direct download link (https://www.gov.br/.../<file>.zip/@@download/file), saves month file name, checks downloaded file really zip archive, clear message ANAC returns web page instead.

title: flightsbr v1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-21 Minor changes: package tries download multiples fails ones, package now try download files failed first attempt. function read_aircrafts() now throws error, deprecated favor read_aircraft() simply fix typo function name. behavior outputs identical. read_airfares() read_flights() now cache list dates/files available ANAC session-scoped temp file, governed existing cache parameter. avoids re-scraping ANAC’s website every single call within R session. Files now downloaded using httr2::req_perform_parallel(), replacing curl::multi_download(). Bug fixes: Fixed error reading data ANAC website. Fixed #52 #51. Fixed select parameter read_airfares(), silently ignored effect columns returned. now behaves way select read_flights(). Fixed get_airfares_dates_available() (used internally read_airfares()) retry requests ANAC fail transiently (timeouts, connection errors, HTTP 429/503) instead silently dropping affected year returning incomplete list available dates. Fixed get_airfares_dates_available() latest_airfares_date() fail cleanly NULL ANAC can’t reached, instead occasionally producing nonsensical “data available Inf -Inf” error, -Inf date. Replaced brittle hardcoded filename-length check (nchar == 55) used filter valid international airfare files listed ANAC explicit filename-pattern check, added equivalent check domestic airfare listing (previously filter ). guards malformed, duplicate, misplaced files ANAC occasionally publishes (e.g. typo’d names, files uploaded wrong year, re-uploads (1) appended) corrupting list available dates. New contributors Arthur Bazolli
